purpose: Move the strongest semantic product review before candidate immutability. Public-release PR review must not be the first semantic review of a candidate tree.

rules.rule: The reviewed head SHA must equal the exact authoritative dev head selected for freeze.

Any commit after the latest semantic review invalidates that review for freeze, even when the commit appears metadata-only, unless the freeze operation proves the candidate tree is exactly identical to the reviewed tree.
Any P1 or P2 semantic product finding blocks freeze. A fix requires a new exact-head semantic review.
The pre-freeze PR base is the exact development baseline so the review covers the full successor delta rather than an arbitrarily truncated diff.

Candidate freeze is an empty/tree-identical provenance commit or exact reviewed commit identity; product, framework, regression and qualification-tool bytes may not change between clean semantic review and freeze.

The public-release PR after freeze remains a publication/provenance gate. Any product finding there still rejects the frozen candidate and forces a successor version, but the process treats such a finding as a failure of the pre-freeze review system requiring root-cause analysis before the next successor freeze.

historical_reason.lesson: A semantic reviewer that repeatedly finds release blockers after freeze belongs before freeze.
